description: eBay sold listings API for AI agents: send a keyword, get sold items as JSON for resale comps: sold price, currency, shipping, total, sale date, condition, listing type, bids, seller feedback. Eight eBay marketplaces, last 1 to 90 days, new or used. No seller names or thumbnails. A search with no results is not charged.

condition.description: only new or only used items (default any)

days.description: sold within the last this many days (1 to 90, default 30)

keyword.description: what was sold, as typed into eBay's search, e.g. "mechanical keyboard" (2 to 100 characters)

limit.description: number of sold listings wanted, 1 to 100 (default 20). A larger value is lowered to 100 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

name: ebay-sold
title: eBay sold prices for resale comps
